name: @local/vibe64-execution
description: Single Vibe64 command execution policy gateway.

surfaces.summary: Runs Vibe64 commands through one actor, environment, runtime path, policy, and execution gateway.

Starts one finite command as Node's spawn or execFile would, with exactly the environment given, in the editor's command spawner once the server has started it at boot: for Vibe64's own fixed tools; a project's commands go through the gateway.
What the machine running Vibe64 provides: tool packs, shared caches, a privileged helper and shared group access.
A session's own Gradle user home and the shared read-only dependency cache, which every Gradle command in a session with a gradle connection gets.
Where the privileged helper keeps the accounts, service units and sudo rules it makes, and the command its later runs start it with, as the host's helper settings name them.
Whether a process the kernel still lists has ended, and the /proc stat reading it takes: a zombie leader whose process still runs other threads has not.
The editor server's stop as its process sees it: one moment, as the stop signal handler begins, after which the command gateway starts nothing and work on its own schedule begins its own stop.
Low-level PTY terminal session lifecycle owned by the execution gateway.
